name: succinonitrile
source_citation: Świergiel & Jadzyn (2013) J. Chem. Eng. Data 58, 128-131
notes: Roster-gap fill (W17-1). Succinonitrile already carries 17 relative-permittivity observations in data/processed/dielectric_observations_v11plus.csv, at 17 distinct temperatures from 333.15 K to 373.15 K (source_doi 10.1021/je300958c), but it has no row in the v0.3 roster. The stored leg is the lowest-temperature observation (333.15 K, epsilon 56.09, expanded uncertainty 0.1 combined, 95 percent). The whole series sits above v0.3's extended window (313.15-323.15 K), so the row is stamped the new, explicitly declared band high_temperature (333.15-373.15 K) rather than being forced into an existing band; no v0.3 band is widened. Because there is no observation inside the room window, the row is model_ready=false. The numeric facts are already committed in the v1.x observation table, which is why redistribution_status is allowed and no separate source licence is asserted.
rationale: 17 observations exist in the v1.x table, none in the roster; W17-1 roster-gap fix, no value invented.

name: gamma-valerolactone
source_citation: Segato, Baratta, Belanzoni, Belpassi, Del Zotto & Zuccaccia (2021) Inorg. Chim. Acta 522, 120372
notes: Value-conflict leg (W17-1). Segato et al. 2021 measure gamma-valerolactone as a green solvent and report a static relative permittivity of 36.9 in the supporting information. The row is a dual-row entry against the pre-existing v0.3 leg (36.1, iScience 2026 Table 3, open-access review table) and nothing is averaged. Under the project rule that the main value follows source quality, the primary supporting-information measurement (this row) is the stronger leg; the review-table leg keeps its own row and is only re-annotated (see dielectric_v04_provenance_patches.csv). Neither leg carries a measurement temperature, so both stay model_ready=false and the pair is flagged unresolved. The DOI and the citation were resolved independently through Crossref (Inorganica Chimica Acta vol. 522, article 120372, July 2021); the upstream Reaxys queue row that surfaced the value carried no DOI. That queue row also mislabels the compound's InChIKey as JYVATQXCHBTGRN-UHFFFAOYSA-N; RDKit and the frozen v0.3 row both give GAEKPEKOJKCEMS-UHFFFAOYSA-N, which is the key used here. The Reaxys queue file is preserved verbatim and is not rewritten.
rationale: dual-row conflict entry (36.9 primary SI leg vs 36.1 review-table leg); conflict not averaged per project discipline.
